data.name: Page_Description
data.value: Describe what a good item looks like for your build. After that, every item you copy in game is judged against it.

data.value: Summed across the baseline of every slot (imported with the build, or captured in game). Only additive stats (life, energy shield, resistances) can be estimated without a full damage engine.

data.name: Baseline_Import_Note
data.value: When you import a PoB share code or a poe.ninja link, the gear in that build comes in with it — one import is enough for a baseline, no hovering needed. Hovering in game is only for filling in slots the build does not have.

data.value: Paste a PoB share code or a pobb.in link. The whole template is filled in from that build: per-slot minimums come from its gear, character totals from the sum of its gear, and its gear becomes the baseline new items are compared against.

data.name: Craft_Prob_Total_Title
data.value: Expected cost (average attempts × cost per attempt)

data.name: Craft_Prob_Total_None
data.value: No expected cost to show — the affix weight data or the price data is missing.

data.name: Craft_Prob_Note_Source
data.value: Affix weights come from Path of Building's recombinator experiments plus trade-site statistics (a community reverse-engineering estimate). The game does not publish success rates, so this is a reference value, not a promise.

data.name: Craft_Prob_Note_Mean
data.value: Expected attempts is an average: on average 1 in N attempts hits the target — it does not mean "N attempts is guaranteed".

data.name: Craft_Prob_Note_Chaos
data.value: Replacement (Chaos Orb): every use removes a random existing affix, so repeated rolling can wipe other good affixes. The expected attempts below only describe how hard it is to hit the target — not how many good affixes survive.

data.name: Craft_Prob_Note_Degraded
data.value: ⚠ Defence values unavailable — the pool is estimated from the slot only (tags: {0}), so the result is optimistic.

data.name: Craft_Prob_Note_Degraded_Short

data.value: The cap depends on your character, ascendancy and gear - the default is 75, please double check it (+maximum resistance mods, for example).

data.name: Basket_Attribute_Note
data.value: Attributes granted by the items only (no passives, ascendancy or quest rewards).

data.name: Basket_Compare_Unparsable
data.value: ⚠️ The equipped snapshot holds no resistance/attribute at all. That is normal if that item genuinely has none; it can also mean the snapshot's item text failed to parse (e.g. item-language setting mismatch), in which case this before/after comparison is wrong.

data.name: Basket_No_Snapshot
data.value: No baseline for that slot yet, so only the total is shown. Import a build (its gear becomes the baseline), or hover that piece in game, press your item hotkey and capture it here.

data.name: Basket_Note_Scope
data.value: Only resistances/attributes on the items are counted: no passive tree, no ascendancy, no quest rewards, no flasks.

data.name: Basket_Note_AllEle
data.value: "+X% to all Elemental Resistances" is counted once for fire, cold and lightning each - that is why the three numbers add up to more than the modifier.

data.name: Basket_Note_Additive
data.value: Only additive mods count ("+X% resistance" / "+X attribute"). Multiplicative mods such as "increased resistance" are ignored.

data.name: Basket_Target_Note
data.value: Resistance targets are taken from Settings > Build Target > Character totals when set; resistances without one fall back to the adjustable cap below.

data.name: Basket_Cap_Note_Bd
data.value: This cap only applies to resistances that have no Build Target value.
